title: davallia thwaitesii
intro: Davallia thwaitesii, commonly known as the Thwaites' Davallia or Thwaites' fern, is a species of fern in the family Davalliaceae. This plant is native to Sri Lanka and is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing blood pressure, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Davallia thwaitesii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties. Further research is necessary to confirm the full extent of the plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions.
